{"diagnosis":"raw_transactions has 4835 rows but only 4814 distinct txn_id values, and the ids are contiguous from 900001 to 904814. So the extra rows look like re-delivered copies of the same transactions across batches. silver_transactions has no dedup, so those copies pass the POSTED filter and appear as duplicate keys. The fix keeps the latest delivery per txn_id before filtering on status.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.6,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) AS rn
  FROM raw_transactions
)
SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id,
       customer_id,
       CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id,
       CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount,
       CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts,
       CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED';"}}
